title: Nilaave Vaa
desc: Siluvai, a Christian man, wants to get married to Sangeetha, a Hindu woman who is already engaged to Siva. Her father is against their union, but Siva decides to help them.

title: Kadhalum Kadanthu Pogum
desc: When a rugged thug with a hidden gentle side meets his newly single, IT consultant neighbour, an improbable romance blossoms against all odds.

title: 36 Vayathinile
desc: Vasanthi leads a mundane life until her friend encourages her to rediscover herself.

title: Unnale Unnale
desc: During a flight to Melbourne, Karthik befriends Deepika. Upon arrival in Australia, Karthik discovers that Deepika is a colleague of his former lover, Jhansi.

title: Attagasam
desc: Jeeva and Guru are twins who get separated in childhood by their mother in order to save their lives. When they reunite several years later, Guru swaps places with Jeeva.
